parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and null values for all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`), leaving only the cluster ID string and a Jaccard similarity of 0.75 as evidence. While the ID string names two types — `ShaderArgumentValue` in `ParameterStore.swift:282` and `ParameterValue` in `ThemeManifest.swift:512` — both within the `Shared/Wallpaper` package, there is no field list, method list, or context-flag data to ground a concrete refactor recommendation. Without member-level evidence it is impossible to determine whether the structural overlap is domain-meaningful (warranting extraction or a shared protocol) or merely coincidental (e.g., both are value-typed enums with a similar case count). Recommending an action without that grounding would violate the no-hallucination rule, so no-action is the correct outcome.
